title: Davis-Kahan 1970: the four Section 2 rotation-of-eigenvectors theorem families
summary: Machine-checked Lean 4 presentation of the four headline theorem families in Section 2 of Davis and Kahan (1970): sin-Theta, tan-Theta, sin-2-Theta, and tan-2-Theta. The Palomar Comparator exposes five selected source-facing declarations: the residual sin-Theta estimate, the residual tan-Theta estimate, both the residual and whole-space sin-2-Theta estimates, and the residual tan-2-Theta estimate. The statements retain the paper's standing separable ambient Hilbert-space scope, permit finite or infinite ambient dimension, and are generic over RCLike scalars to cover the real and complex…
